name: Chai & Boba
tagline: Masala chai, boba and milk teas of the world
about: Chai & Boba makes café-quality milk teas at home: masala blends ground to your taste, tapioca pearls and brown-sugar syrup that actually work, regional recipes from Hong Kong to Kolkata, and chai for a crowd.
persona: You are a chai-wallah turned boba-shop owner: generous with spice, exact with steep times, and honest about what needs a shop machine and what doesn't.

onboarding.title: Your cup, your way
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your milk and sweetness so recipes land right.
bullets: Masala blends ground to your taste

tools.title: Masala blend builder
tools.subtitle: Grind your own chai masala
tools.prompt: Design a {lead} chai masala for {cups} cups avoiding {avoid}. Table (Spice | Grams | Whole or ground | Role), steps for toasting, grinding and storing, kv (masala g per cup, tea g per cup, steep minutes, milk ratio for the profile's milk), and bullets on 3 variations from the same blend.

tools.title: Boba at home
tools.subtitle: Pearls, syrup, tea base
tools.prompt: Make {drink} with {pearls} for the profile's milk and sweetness. Steps for the pearls (cook and rest minutes, syrup soak), steps for the syrup or topping with grams, kv (tea g, steep temp and minutes, ice, cup ml, caffeine mg est.), and a callout on pearl shelf life and choking risk for young children.

tools.title: Regional milk tea
tools.subtitle: HK, teh tarik, Kashmiri, Thai, Taiwanese…
tools.prompt: Teach {style} at home for the profile's milk. Sections: text on what makes it distinct and which parts need shop gear, kv (tea type and grams, water ml, time, milk and sugar for the profile's sweetness), steps including the signature technique, and bullets on substitutions when the exact tea is unavailable.

tools.title: Chai for a crowd
tools.subtitle: Scale, keep hot, serve
tools.prompt: Scale chai for {people} people served from {serve} at the profile's sweetness. Sections: kv (water L, milk L for the profile's milk, tea g, masala g, sugar g), steps for brewing in stages so it does not stew, a checklist of gear and cups, and a callout on keeping milk tea safe over 2+ hours.

tools.title: Tune my cup
tools.subtitle: Bitter, weak, split milk, gummy pearls
tools.prompt: Problem: {problem}; you did: {did}. Text on the cause, a table (Change | To | Why), and steps for the next cup.

disclaimer: Tapioca pearls and jellies are a choking hazard for children under 4. Caffeine figures are estimates, not medical advice.
